evidence: source:src/infowin.h and src/statuswin.h declare the two callees, but neither has a product definition; the former MainInterface forwarders hid that absence. A fresh Release link reports their exact symbols as unresolved: ?on_left_click@InfoWin@@QAEXHH@Z and ?on_right_click@StatusWin@@QAEXHHH@Z.

source:the 0x00458930 seed calls InfoWin::draw_text (0x00458420), timer_change (0x00458FF0) and StatusWin::reset (0x004B8970), and writes original global 0x006E8150. The 0x004B9010 seed exposes a larger menu/lifetime family and an independent exception tail. Their opaque globals, guessed classes and manual vptr stores are hints to replace, not code to copy into product source.
payload.hypothesis: The recovered MainInterface click dispatch exposes missing product definitions for InfoWin::on_left_click and StatusWin::on_right_click. Recover their real dependency families instead of reinstating executable-address forwarders or substituting no-op definitions.
